1984.terms: 2kratings.com's page of NBA 2K27's MyNBA Eras league that starts in 1983/84, as of 8 November 2026: each club's opening-night roster with 2K's own overall (1-99) and position. 1999.label: NBA Live 99
1999.name: The NLSC
1999.terms: 'NBA Live 99 Original 1998 Rosters' 1.0 (8 March 2017, uploaded by Andrew) from the NLSC's Downloads database: EA's own roster files from the NBA Live 99 PC CD-ROM (© EA Sports 1998), no licence given. The .7z (MD5 6280cd1d87748d80689c053037c028e0) is pinned as downloaded, and its PLAYERS.DBF and TEAMS.DBF as extracted; only those two dBase tables are read, as data. Because of the 1998 lockout the game shipped with the final 1997/98 rosters plus the trades of May and June 1998 and none of the 1998 draft; the season is 1998/99, the edition's, as NBA 2K12 carries 2011/12 on the lockout's 2010/11 rosters. Free agents and the All-Star teams are left out, and so is every player Basketball-Reference (check) does not have playing in the NBA: the made-up 'Roster Player' and a draft pick who never played. Each player keeps EA's computed overall (OVERALLRTG) as `raw`, put on NBA 2K's scale by `scale`.

scale.note: NBA Live 99's overall is the rounded mean of 17 of its ratings, so it runs low (28-71 here) and undervalues specialists. One straight line puts it on NBA 2K's scale: the least-squares line of NBA 2K's overall (2K Archive's NBA 2K, 1999/00) on NBA Live 99's, through the players both editions rate, matched by name or alias. rating = round(20.22 + 1.089 × raw); its slope is positive, so no player passes another. The build fits the line again and stops if it is not this one. The audit gives every raw overall's rating and how the line does on those players.

2012.name: The Real 2K Insider
2012.terms: The pinned copy is the Wayback Machine's capture of 14 October 2011 (the live page's markup changes from one fetch to the next; its list does not). A fan blog with no licence; its ratings are 2K's launch ratings, transcribed from 2K's ratings video, on the lockout's launch rosters (the 2010/11 teams), as 2K Archive's are. 2K Archive lists only 3 Philadelphia and San Antonio players for NBA 2K12, so the season comes from this list whole; the audit counts how many of 2K Archive's players it rates the same.

check.name: Basketball-Reference's player seasons (Sumitro Datta, NBA Stats (1947-present), version 57)
check.terms: CC0: Public Domain, compiled from Basketball-Reference's regular seasons (dataset updated 1 November 2026). Read only to check facts: who played for which club in which season, and for how long. `codes` maps the manifest's team codes to Basketball-Reference's where they differ; `rotation` is the minutes a season's real player must have played for his club for the audit to name him if a source does not list him.
